messages:
ryan_s: Hey team — FinData POC blocked. Private installer fails during node prep. Logs show CUDA/lib mismatch and a cert verify error when contacting customer's KMS. Need quick preflight checklist.

jia_l: Can you paste the top of the installer log and node OS/kernel + whether nodes are air-gapped?

ryan_s: Installer snippet:
```
2026-03-20T15:12:03Z ERROR tls: handshake failed: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
2026-03-20T15:12:05Z ERROR runtime: CUDA version mismatch: libcuda reported 470.199 vs toolkit 520
```
Nodes: Ubuntu 20.04, kernel 5.15. Air-gapped (no internet), but allowed egress to our KMS (kms.finedata.internal:443) via proxy.

owen_field: Quick checks:
`nvidia-smi`
`sudo modinfo nvidia | grep -i version`
`lsmod | grep nvidia`
`kubectl get nodes -o wide`
Also check device plugin ds:
`kubectl -n kube-system get ds nvidia-device-plugin-daemonset -o wide`

samir_eng: CUDA mismatch means userspace toolkit != driver. In air-gapped, driver packages often old. Preferred driver for our stack = 525+ for most modern models. Steps:
1) `sudo apt remove --purge 'nvidia-*'`
2) install driver package (from offline .deb) and reboot
Note: kernel module must match driver; reboot required.

owen_field: For the x509 error check time sync (`timedatectl`) and CA bundle. If proxy does TLS interception, you need the proxy CA in `/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt` or system store.
Test with:
`openssl s_client -connect kms.finedata.internal:443 -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt`
If you see `verify error:num=20:self signed certificate`, add CA.

deploy-bot: New logs uploaded: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/1912345678/installer.tar.gz

sales_ce: Timeline note — FinData needs demo by Mon. Is there a Hosted API fallback we can demo while infra is fixed?

jia_l: Hosted keys would violate their data policy (sensitive PII). Sales can offer short Dedicated pool credit for demo. @sales_ce can you confirm pricing?

sales_ce: We can spin a small Dedicated pool for 2 weeks; send me a PO and I'll attach credits. Pricing team ok with promo.

owen_field: Also double-check container runtime GPU support: `crictl ps` + `crictl exec` into gpu-enabled pod. Ensure `nvidia-container-runtime` or `nvidia-container-toolkit` present.

ryan_s: Followed steps: installed driver 525 (offline .deb), added customer CA to system store, synced time. Rebooted. Re-ran installer — node prep succeeded and KMS handshake ok. Installer finished. POC now proceeds.

samir_eng: Nice. For record, paste final outputs: `nvidia-smi` and `openssl s_client` success. We'll add this to preflight doc.

ryan_s: nvidia-smi output: `Driver Version: 525.89.02`, openssl shows `Verify return code: 0 (ok)` :thumbsup: 

owen_field: Closing loop — will add a short checklist to FinData ticket and attach offline driver bundle and CA steps.
